title: The Owner sees everything waiting on them in one Inbox: the messages to send and the decisions, with one count
description: What needs the Owner is split in two. The decision cards (merges, open the next region) are on Sign-offs with a saffron count, and the drafted messages they actually send every day sit on the Flows page and are not in that count. Make the Inbox the one place: a 'Messages to send' section with the flow's DraftsInbox, and a 'Decisions' section with the card queue, which says 'No decisions waiting' when there are none. The page says how many of each wait ('2 messages to send and 1 decision waiting on you'); a ready message is a draft with no blanks left that is not sent or handled. The nav's Inbox count, the top bar's 'needs you' pill and the tab title count open decisions plus ready messages. Unknown counts are left out, never shown as zero. Nothing here sends anything.
acceptance: The Inbox page has a Messages to send section with the flow's drafts and a Decisions section with the open cards
The page says how many messages and decisions are waiting
With no open cards the Decisions section says No decisions waiting and the messages still show
The nav's Inbox count is open decisions plus ready messages
